rows.title: Productivity Reset
rows.description: This 7-day challenge helps you reset focus, reduce procrastination, and rebuild productive momentum — without burnout.

rows.title: Unburn
rows.description: A comprehensive 30-day program to understand, manage, and recover from burnout.

metadata.tile1_content: Don't let burnout drain your spark. With our Bite-sized daily steps reclaim your energy and peace of mind in 35 days.
metadata.tile2_content:
Daily micro-lessons (5-10 minutes)
Evidence-based CBT techniques
Progress tracking & insights
Practical and useful tips
metadata.tile3_content:
Complete your daily lessons at your own pace
Track your patterns and progress
Practice new techniques each day
Review your insights and adjust your plan
metadata.tile4_content:
Restored Mental & Physical Energy. Overcome chronic exhaustion and feel genuinely recharged
Clear Mental Boundaries. Protect your mental bandwidth and stop taking stress home
Sustainable Work Habits. Create a pace of life you can maintain without burning out
Renewed Passion & Focus. Feel engaged, present, and motivated in your day-to-day
metadata.eligibility_point_3: Real world ways to challenge burnout

rows.title: Sleep Tight
rows.description:
A gentle, guided program to help you understand and improve your sleep. There’s nothing to “fix” immediately 
. We’ll start by noticing patterns and building consistency.

metadata.tile1_content: Having trouble sleeping? I-Kan's Sleep Tight module is here. We know quality sleep is essential for your well-being. Over the next  31 days, we'll work together to address your sleep troubles and help you achieve restful nights, improving your health, focus, and mood.
metadata.tile2_content:
Daily micro-lessons (5-10 minutes)
Evidence-based CBT techniques
Progress tracking & insights
Personalized sleep plan
metadata.tile3_content:
Complete your daily lessons at your own pace
Track your sleep patterns and progress
Practice new techniques each day
Review your insights and adjust your plan
metadata.tile4_content:
Better Sleep Quality. Fall asleep faster and wake up refreshed
Reduced Sleep Anxiety. Stop worrying about sleep and feel more in control
Sustainable Habits. Build routines that last beyond the program
Improved Daily Energy. Feel more alert and energized during the day
